create_NGRAMWorker: create an NGRAMWorker instance for speculative ngram decoding with a target worker and server args
add_external_corpus_NGRAMWorker: add an external ngram corpus to the NGRAMWorker from pre-tokenized token chunks
run_forward_batch_generation_NGRAMWorker: run forward batch generation with ngram speculative decoding on a schedule batch
list_external_corpora_NGRAMWorker: list all external ngram corpora loaded in the NGRAMWorker with their token counts
remove_external_corpus_NGRAMWorker: remove a named external ngram corpus from the NGRAMWorker by corpus id
